c74object.name: evi.formantfilter.morph~
c74object.digest: A formant filter with smoothly morphing singing voice type, sung vowel sounds and filter types.
c74object.description: While the alternative evi.formantfilter~ uses a bank of resonant filters, this evi.formantfilter.morph~ uses a bank of morphing EQ filters. The formant effect is lesser, but the morphing ability creates new sonic possibilities. The far right 'Morph' inlet allows for morphing the internal bank of filters between LP..BP..HP..NOTCH..LP 0..1, and adds another dimension along with the voice and vowel morphing to shape the sound. All inputs can be audio rate modulated.

inlet.description: Linearly interpolate the singing voice types between Bass..Tenor..CounterTenor..Alto..Soprano. A typical use case would be to attach an X/Y pad to inlets 2 and 3.
Linearly interpolate the vowel formants between A..E..I..O..U. A typical use case would be to attach an X/Y pad to inlets 2 and 3.
Linearly interpolate the bank of internal filters between types LP..BP..HP..NOTCH..LP over a range of 0..1.

outlet.digest: Current Formant Frequency in Hz (depending on 'formantfrequency' param)
outlet.description: Current Formant Frequency in Hz (depending on 'formantfrequency' param).

attribute.name: bwwarp
attribute.description: Multiply (warp) formants bandwidth size. 1 = no warping. Smaller values increase resonance.

attribute.name: cfwarp
attribute.description: Multiply (warp) formants frequency center. 1 = no warping. < 1 shifts downwards, > 1 shifts upwards.

attribute.name: datainterp
attribute.description: Affects the way the maximums (to 1.) are handled for inlets 2 and 3. 0=clip, 1=wrap.

attribute.name: datatype
attribute.description: Affects the way the voice/vowel interpolation sounds (interpolates linear or logarithmic data).

attribute.name: formantfrequency
attribute.description: A utility. Out2 sends out the frequency of which formant? Integer 0..4 = formants 1..5. Can be useful for extracting data for downstream processes.

attribute.name: gainnorm
attribute.description: 0 respects the physical modelling of the voice, using the gain data to attenuate the formants. 1 ignores the formants gain data and normalises the gain of all formants. The can be useful to balance the overall filter effect.

attribute.name: gainwarp
attribute.description: Multiply (warp) formants gain amount. 1 = no warping. < 1 is quieter, > 1 is louder.

attribute.name: paramsmooth
attribute.description: Global internal parameter smoothing in ms.

attribute.name: warpsmooth
attribute.description: Turn off or on the smoothing of the warp parameters (@cfwarp, @bwwarp, @gainwarp). If using the warp attributes this should be on. Turning off can save CPU.
